# NPE Action

> > Network for Public Education Action is a grassroots advocacy organization defending public schools against privatization, billionaire influence, and federal policy threats.

NPE Action, founded by education scholar Diane Ravitch, mobilizes school board members, educators, and citizens to protect public education through advocacy campaigns, political endorsements, and national conferences. The organization focuses on countering charter school expansion, billionaire interference in school elections, and threats to public education funding and policy.
